title: Contents Packout & Storage Final Invoice and Job Closing
content:
**The job must be in returned status when the final invoice is issued. The final invoice amount is the total of every charge line on the job, and the payment due date is the invoice date plus the self-pay or insurance payment terms by funding source, counted in calendar days. The job closes when its balance due is exactly zero after invoicing.**

This rule governs issuing the final invoice on a Contents Packout & Storage job and closing the job.

## Condition – result

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| When the invoice may be issued | the job is in returned status |
| Invoice amount | the total of every charge line on the job |
| Payment due date, self-pay job | the invoice date plus the tier's self-pay payment terms, in calendar days |
| Payment due date, insurance-funded job | the invoice date plus the tier's insurance payment terms, in calendar days |
| Closing | the balance due is exactly zero after invoicing |

The payment terms are the tier values in the product's billing office schedule.

## Cases (hypothetical figures)

- With hypothetical terms of 21 days, an invoice dated the 5th of a 31-day month is due on the 26th of that month.
- A job whose balance due after invoicing is 0.00 closes; a balance of 0.01 or of minus 0.01 is not exactly zero, and the job stays invoiced.
